entities.summary: Cabeceiras de Basto is a municipality in the district of Braga in Portugal. The population in 2011 was 16,710, in an area of 241.82 km². Cabeceiras de Basto was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
